method: Deterministic in-process benchmark, 15 seeds per input profile, comparison counter per algorithm.

hypothesis: A threshold pair exists that reproduces every human label in the labelled verification case set with zero false supports.
method: Exhaustive sweep of 132 threshold combinations, evaluated against 26 hand-labelled claim/document pairs; selection is lexicographic on false supports, recall, F1, macro F1, distance from the documented default, then strictness.

excluded_cases.name: unit substitution not detected
excluded_cases.reason: The verifier compares numeric literals, not unit words, so a currency substitution is not a hard failure. The case is kept in the set so the limitation stays visible, and it is excluded from the threshold selection objective so that it cannot be hidden by tuning.

result_json.falsifier: No swept threshold pair achieves zero false supports, or the best pair disagrees with a non-excluded labelled case.
result_json.hypothesis: A threshold pair exists that reproduces every human label in the labelled verification case set with zero false supports.
result_json.limitation: The labelled cases are synthetic and were written by this project. The measured accuracy therefore reflects agreement with the project's own adjudication standard, and a different annotator could disagree with individual labels. The full case list and the sweep grid are published so that a reviewer can re-label and re-run. The excluded case is published with its reason.
